title: Ephemeral canary lanes with contract probes and stateful shadow validation
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: we need a lightweight, short-lived canary lane that can validate contract-level invariants (schema, latency, token-usage) while exercising stateful paths (KV-cache warmup, streaming handoffs) without committing traffic for long periods. This PR introduces ephemeral canary lanes (lease-based lanes that auto-expire), contract probes that assert route-level invariants, and stateful shadow validation that replays a sampled subset of live requests against canary models in a read-only mode. High-level changes: 1) lane-manager: lease allocator, fast spin-up path, and reclaimed resources metrics; 2) contract-probe subsystem: config-driven schema checks, p95/99 guards, and cost budgets; 3) shadow-validator: stateful replay harness that can optionally warm KV cache and compare outputs deterministically or with fuzzy thresholds; 4) rollout-sim: a simulation tool that runs a proposed rollback/roll-forward in a sandbox and returns a risk score before committing; 5) API additions: rollout config now accepts ephemeral_lanes {lease_seconds, cohort_hash, probe_policy}; 6) Console: UI addition to show ephemeral lane lifecycle and probe results. Checklist: - [x] design doc and Linear tickets linked (ENG-1284, ENG-1309) - [x] unit tests for lane lifecycle - [x] e2e simulation harness and replay tests - [x] docs and API schema updates - [x] manual canary smoke validation in staging How it works: ephemeral lanes are created by the rollout controller when a canary is requested. Each lane acquires a short-lived lease from the lane-manager; if the controller does not extend the lease, it is reclaimed automatically and traffic is drained. Contract probes run against every response produced by the canary lane and evaluate schema, a latency budget (p95), and a token-cost delta relative to a golden baseline. The shadow-validator runs concurrently on a sampled subset of traffic in read-only mode; it replays requests into the canary environment but isolates side effects via a reversible wrapper or a sandboxed replica when available. The rollout-sim tool executes a simulated swap/rollback in-memory using historical traces and the current SLOs to compute a risk score (0-100) and recommended holdpoints. Backwards compatibility: the API extension is additive; existing rollout configs continue to work. Migration: control plane persists lane leases with TTL; older controllers will ignore ephemeral_lanes fields. Testing and signals: added new metrics (lane_lease_acquire_ms, probe_failure_rate, replay_consistency_score). We included an e2e scenario that reproduces a KV-warmup failure from an in-production incident to validate the guard. Related work: complements shadow-verifier and rollout-graph work (see PRs: #60321, #54823). Merge: squash and merge after CI green and two approvals.

review_comments: Priya Kaur (reviewer): Can the probe thresholds be configured per-route? I'm concerned about noisy routes that always exceed p95. Requesting a per-route override mechanism.
Sofia Martinez (author): Yes — policies.yml supports route-scoped overrides and a fallback global policy. I added tests for route overrides and documented the precedence in the API schema.
Ethan Park (reviewer): The lane lease code looks reasonable but we need a safety valve in case a controller crashes and never releases. How do we avoid resource leakage?

Sofia Martinez (author): Leases have a TTL and the lane-manager reclaims after lease TTL + grace window. We also emit lease_stale_alert and added reconciler logic to force-drain lanes older than X days. See lane-manager/metrics.go for metrics.

Liam O'Connor (reviewer): CI failed lint in the first run due to a formatting mismatch in rollout_sim.go. Also please add a short doc note about the console permission required to see ephemeral lanes.
Sofia Martinez (author): Fixed formatting and added console permission note to docs/rollouts/ephemeral-lanes.md. Re-ran CI which is now green.
Priya Kaur (reviewer): Approved after docs and per-route overrides. +1
Ethan Park (reviewer): Approved. Verified e2e scenario reproduces the staging failure locally. +1
merge_result: merged (squash) by Sofia Martinez after two approvals and green CI
release_notes: Add ephemeral canary lanes (lease-based), contract probes (schema/latency/cost guards), a stateful shadow replay validator, and a rollout simulation tool to compute risk scores before commit. API extended with ephemeral_lanes block; add-on metrics documented.
notes_for_ops: Operators should monitor lane_lease_acquire_ms, probe_failure_rate, and replay_consistency_score after rollout. Default lease_seconds=1800; tune per-workload. In case of lease storm, use admin endpoint /admin/leases/clear to revoke ephemeral lanes.
testing_summary: Unit coverage added for lease lifecycle and probe evaluation. E2E harness replays a production trace and asserts no side-effects (sandbox mode) and consistency_score > 98 for golden baseline. Manual staging run performed with a synthetic traffic cohort and validated console metrics and automated rollback from rollout-sim.
